synthesis: The 'HTML instead of JSON' failure in Scout's admin Bird's Eye org-map is a FRONTEND ROUTING LEAK, not a backend 500. Bird's Eye (DEV-2116) reuses the driver Vue SPA + Pinia stores via a client-side adminMode flag; in admin mode lib/fetch.js buildUrl() targets BASE_URL=/scout/org-map/api. That admin route group (routes/web.php) registers only a subset of the driver endpoints and ends with a Vue-Router SPA catch-all `Route::get('{any?}', fn () => view('clarity-scout-birds-eye'))`. Any driver-only fetch NOT gated on !mapStore.adminMode targets a path with no admin mirror (/shift/status, /notifications, /me, /trips/*), matches the catch-all, and gets a legitimate 200 text/html shell — so response.ok is true and response.json() throws `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '<'`. Laravel's Accept:application/json header only affects EXCEPTION rendering, not a successful view-route match, which is why the reporter thought 'Filament ignores the Accept header'. The literal sink named by the ticket's console text (fetchKitPosition/fetchLivePath via useKitPositionPolling→LiveTracking) is ALREADY FIXED on current main (DEV-2164 added MapShell's !mapStore.adminMode gate; DEV-2179 re-confirmed it; commit 3c52ff50 is an ancestor of HEAD). The actual all-driver positions path (driverPositions/driverPaths via useBirdsEyePolling + ScannerMap's adminMode ternary) is correctly gated and its controllers already try/catch every ClickHouse read to return JSON on failure. The STILL-LIVE instance of the same bug class is App.vue's `watch(() => auth.isAuthenticated, {immediate:true})`, which unconditionally calls shift.fetchStatus()+notifications.fetch(); auth.isAuthenticated is true in admin mode (isAuthenticated = !!token || adminMode; enterAdminMode() runs before mount), so both fetch driver-only paths with no admin mirror on every Bird's Eye load. Today these errors are swallowed silently (call sites .catch without console.error), so they do not reproduce the LITERAL 'Failed to fetch kit position' message, but they ARE a real, current AC1 violation (HTML served for a JSON call).

scope.summary: Close the still-live admin-mode fetch leak and make AC1 durable: (1) gate App.vue's shift/notifications watch on !mapStore.adminMode; (2) add a JSON-404 catch-all inside the /scout/org-map/api route group so ANY unmatched admin-api path returns JSON instead of the SPA HTML shell; (3) add PHPUnit feature tests pinning the JSON-404 fallback and (new) driverPositions() coverage. Frontend build assets must be rebuilt+committed (public/build is tracked).
